description:
[Step 2 of find_a_clinician]

Returns Emora clinicians who fit a state, service, insurance and child's age, ranked by clinical fit when concerns are given, then by availability and reviews. Each result has the clinician's next opening. Ten per page; limit and offset page through the rest.

Use when: A family wants to see clinicians: therapists, psychiatric prescribers, psychologists for testing, or intake specialists (service clinical-matching).

Don't use when: The family hasn't said what they're worried about yet: recommend_care orients first.

Example: search_providers({ state: 'Florida', service: 'therapy', concerns: ['social-anxiety'], insurance: 'Aetna', client_age: 12 })

concerns.description: One to three concern IDs from the list. More than three dilutes the ranking.

continuation.description: Token from a previous search_providers result. Repeats its filters; new arguments take precedence.

insurance.description: Insurance plan name, or "Cash Pay" for self-pay. A plan Emora does not take is ignored, and the result says so.

limit.description: Matches to return. Defaults to 10, with no maximum.

offset.description: Matches to skip. next_offset from a previous result gives the next page.

preferred_approaches.description: Therapy approaches, e.g. ["cbt","playTherapy"]. Clinicians who use them rank higher.

preferred_language.description: A language other than English the clinician should speak.

service.description: therapy (the default), clinical-matching (unsure what is needed), medication (non-stimulant only), adhd-testing or autism-testing.

state.description: U.S. state, full name or 2-letter code. For a state Emora does not serve, the result says so and lists alternatives.

name: search_providers
title: Search Emora clinicians
